_doc: Scala. implicit: an implicit definition (def, val, class, object) and a named given carry the flag implicit (flag_mods, defs.scm); dyn.implicit: `import app.Imp._`, `.given`, `.{a, b}` or `.a` is the dynamic site implicit:Imp, which makes the implicit members of Imp used (N, link.py): an implicit is used without a name, so the import is its only trace. private = private, protected = package, no modifier = public. override: the method reaches/is reached through its base (flag override). self_word: a bare name inside a class, trait or object is also this.name (a member of the type or of its ancestors: a subclass calls base_m, a class calls a method of its trait) unless a parameter or a lambda / pattern variable binds it. roots.main has host: the object that holds main is an entry with it (Main alive through Main.main). A live member keeps its type alive only through the linker's file_init and owner rules; apply/unapply/unapplySeq/update/main/run and the members of the stdlib typeclasses are called by the language (protocol). roots.main: a method named main, an object that extends App, IOApp or a ZIO app (the runtime starts them); main-app. path_roots: Play calls controllers, filters and modules by convention.
